name: collapsible
behavior: APG disclosure pattern (trigger is a button carrying aria-expanded + aria-controls; Enter/Space toggle; the panel is hidden from the accessibility tree while collapsed; focus never moves on toggle)

parts.note: owns the open state and the trigger↔panel id wiring; contributes no visual recipe
a real button; its content is caller-supplied — any expand indicator is composed in, not a part of this anatomy
block-size animates between 0 and content height; overflow hidden during the transition; hidden + aria-hidden when closed

anatomyNotes: Collapsible is the single-disclosure primitive that accordion composes: accordion adds item, label and indicator parts plus a shared open policy, collapsible adds none of them. Salt's CollapsiblePanel wraps its children in an inner measuring element and shadcn/Radix animates a CSS variable — both are RECIPE mechanics for the same height transition, not an extra part.
